body.heading: Fill the hats
paragraphs: In the first hat, put animal words: dog, elephant, frog. In the second, put doing words: dances, sleeps, hops.
In the third hat, put place words: in the bath, on the moon, under the table. An adult can write words you call out.

body.heading: Pick and read
paragraphs: Take one slip from each hat and read your sentence out loud: The elephant dances on the moon!
Swap one word at a time and notice how the whole picture in your head changes.

takeaway: Mixing words in new ways makes sentences that can make everyone laugh.
safetyNotes: An adult helps with writing the words and any cutting.
screenFreeExtension: Act out your silliest sentence like a tiny play for your family.
